description: A finite propositional context is syntactically consistent if and only if some Boolean valuation satisfies every member.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.consistent_iff_satisfiable.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Consistent Γ ↔ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Satisfiable Γ
